## Tax Jurisdiction

`country`, `region` and `rate` (PercentageField): a lookup table every priced document for that region reads, so a rate change is made once.

```ts
import { TaxJurisdiction } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/commerce/tax-jurisdiction';

@field taxJurisdiction = linksTo(TaxJurisdiction);
```

A document links its jurisdiction rather than copying the rate, and `orderTotals(items, jurisdiction.rate)` from `line-item-totals` applies it.

### Non-goals
Not a tax engine: no product-category rules, no exemptions, no filing. One flat rate per region.

### Example
`TaxJurisdiction/california-us` at 7.25%.
attributes.cardDescription: A region with its own tax rate — a lookup table reused across every invoice for that region.
